### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building Go backend billing services for Upsun’s cloud application platform. Owning usage-based billing, integrations, reliability, security, and mentoring across a global remote team.
Senior Software Engineer building Go billing services for Upsun’s cloud application platform
- Tech stack: Distributed Systems, MariaDB, MySQL, Postgres, Go
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors UK Skilled Worker visas.
- Design, build, and maintain backend services and API integrations in Go connecting the platform to external billing systems
- Lead the design and delivery of usage-based billing features, including usage aggregation, estimates, usage alerts, and invoicing
- Own complex components end to end from technical design through production
- Shape component architecture, weigh trade-offs, and balance short-term delivery with long-term reliability
- Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed services and external APIs, fixing root causes
- Identify and deliver improvements in reliability, security, observability, and processes
- Contribute to anti-abuse measures and apply security best practices to sensitive customer and payment data
- Support engineers through code reviews, pairing, and mentoring
- Deep professional backend development in Go, building services in distributed systems
- Experience designing backend systems and making architecture decisions that held up in production
- Strong experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL/MariaDB, including data modeling, migrations, and performance
- Track record integrating third-party APIs with rate limits, uptime constraints, idempotency, retries, and consistency considerations
- Experience in domains where correctness matters, such as billing or payments
- Commitment to testing failure paths
- Solid understanding of common vulnerabilities and security considerations in payment and billing systems
- Experience mentoring engineers or guiding technical work while staying hands-on

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building Go backend billing services for Upsun’s cloud application platform. Owning usage-based billing, integrations, reliability, security, and mentoring across a global remote team.
Senior Software Engineer building Go billing services for Upsun’s cloud application platform
Role description:
• Design, build, and maintain backend services and API integrations in Go connecting the platform to external billing systems
• Lead the design and delivery of usage-based billing features, including usage aggregation, estimates, usage alerts, and invoicing
• Own complex components end to end from technical design through production
• Shape component architecture, weigh trade-offs, and balance short-term delivery with long-term reliability
• Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed services and external APIs, fixing root causes
• Identify and deliver improvements in reliability, security, observability, and processes
• Contribute to anti-abuse measures and apply security best practices to sensitive customer and payment data
• Support engineers through code reviews, pairing, and mentoring
• Partner with Finance, Product, Support, and engineering teams across multiple time zones
• Communicate asynchronously across a distributed, global team
Role requirements:
• Deep professional backend development in Go, building services in distributed systems
• Experience designing backend systems and making architecture decisions that held up in production
• Strong experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL/MariaDB, including data modeling, migrations, and performance
• Track record integrating third-party APIs with rate limits, uptime constraints, idempotency, retries, and consistency considerations
• Experience in domains where correctness matters, such as billing or payments
• Commitment to testing failure paths
• Solid understanding of common vulnerabilities and security considerations in payment and billing systems
• Experience mentoring engineers or guiding technical work while staying hands-on
• Interest in working on billing and financial systems
• Clear written communication and ability to build agreement across a distributed team
• Legally authorized to work in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, or the United States
• Must complete a background check
Benefits:
• Flexible PTO
• Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)
• Company stock options
• Professional development budget
• Office equipment budget
• Wellness budget
• Annual team gatherings
• Internet reimbursement
• Inclusive parental leave
• Remote work travel program
• Flexible, open, and inclusive work environment
• Remote work flexibility
• Background check required for all roles
Tech stack:
Distributed Systems, MariaDB, MySQL, Postgres, Go
